name: Eggball.io
summary: Eggball is a free to play multiplayer soccer game played in a web browser, in which each player controls an egg. Players run, jump, dive and head the ball to score in a stadium filled with egg fans, with matches set at different times of day. Players have a profile with stats, levels, weekly leaderboards and quests, and can customize their egg with cosmetic items such as capes, trails and goal explosions.
